description:
## Goal

On the final exact-edge scheduler, eliminate repeated whole-wave minimum scans and Vec removal shifts while preserving typed fact movement, finality and wake semantics.

Reuse the existing transient OrderedWorklist or a smaller equivalent. It is routing, not retained semantic authority. Preserve required equal-key chronology only where final confluence tests prove it observable; do not invent rank caches or another work queue.

Increasing independent and dynamically admitted waves must prove subquadratic total insertion/selection/movement work. Cover retraction, reappearance, content/readiness movements, coalesced wakes and final authoritative state. Delete take_next_fact_change scanning and all probes. Run only after fz-kdt.46 so the ticket optimizes the final wave shape.
title: Eliminate quadratic scheduler fact-wave selection
